title: Fool's Mate -- Chess Variant with Jokers made by Gemini
author: ecce_artemis
selftext:
Fool's Mate is a blitz chess variant game with Jokers. 

The only rule is simple: **Jokers buy you time.** 

Every time you make a move "in-band", which is in top #3 moves calculated by the engine, you get couple seconds added to your time. Jokers carefully crafted by Gemini based on chess tutorials and analytics to encourage better play.

For example:

\- **Each piece's first move, in-band** \-- encourage early development

\- **Castle by move 8** \-- encourage early castle

\- **In-band move that increases the mover's mobility** \-- encourage opening pieces

\- **Attacker added to their king zone, in-band** \-- statistically always good

\- etc, etc, etc

The rougelike mode, the **Climb**, is a typical Balatro-like three rounds mode where you earn case as you play, buy Jokers between sessions, defeat **The Pit Boss.**

Play with a friend also available, feel free to ping me if you would like to give it a try.

Gemini would be grateful for any feedback: [https://foolsmate-e30d2.web.app/](https://foolsmate-e30d2.web.app/)

Made with Gemini and Codex
